# Create: Train Sync

**Client-side fixes for Create trains that suddenly flip, stretch or snap under
uneven updates. No changes to physics, acceleration, braking or train balance.**

**AI disclosure:** this project's code and research analysis were generated by
OpenAI Codex, without human manual implementation edits. The_Stove and a friend
performed real multiplayer playtests. This is not independently human-audited code.
See [the full disclosure](https://github.com/Thestovee/create-train-sync/blob/main/AI_DISCLOSURE.md).

## What it does

- Stops an old interpolation correction from continuing beyond its target.
- When an individual wheel point needs an immediate correction, restores the
  carriage's active wheel points together from a validated snapshot.

## Install

Install the JAR in **your client's** `mods` folder. Minecraft **1.21.1**, NeoForge,
Create **6.0.10**, Java **21**. Every player who wants the fix installs it locally.
No dedicated-server installation or Train Trace is required.

Fabric, Forge, other Minecraft/Create versions and newer Create releases are not
claimed to be supported by this beta. Do not install several versions at once.

## Tested result and limits

In one recorded single-carriage comparison, orientation flips fell from 20 and 26
on the two clients to zero on both. A later six-carriage ICE-3 test also recorded
zero internal flips. These were human-operated sessions, not controlled benchmarks.

This is a targeted fix, not a complete networking rewrite. A whole carriage can
still snap, delayed updates can still cause pauses, and rare spacing differences
between adjacent carriages remain. It does not fix chunk loading, server overload
or Threaded Trains concurrency errors. RailX was present in the tested modpack;
that is not a universal compatibility guarantee.
